name: app/brand-mark
title: BrandMark
summary: An ecosystem brand's official mark (the bundu-ecosystem-icons pair, or, for a brand with no pair, its own shipped mark, never redrawn), with its lower-case serif wordmark and an optional tagline when asked. Both the light-surface and dark-surface marks are in the page; CSS shows the one that fits the theme.

props.name: brand
props.description: Which brand. The set grows by adding the brand's mark pair (128px PNG, light and dark surface).

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered size of the mark in CSS pixels.

props.name: wordmark
props.description: Show the brand name beside the mark.

props.name: suffix
props.description: A muted word after the wordmark ("console").

props.name: tagline
props.description: A muted line under the wordmark, for a mini-app's lockup (Kweli: "mukoko · Africa"). Shown only with `wordmark`.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Empty alt text, when neighbouring text names the brand.

behaviour: The marks are the registry's canonical pair, never redrawn: the bundu-ecosystem-icons pair for nyuchi and mukoko, and Kweli's own shipped mark (a shield with a tick, mono in malachite) for kweli.
Theme switching is CSS ([data-theme], .dark, prefers-color-scheme), no script.
The mark alone carries the brand name as alt text; with the wordmark, or `decorative`, the images are alt="".
A brand outside `values` (from untyped data, or one whose icon pair has not shipped) is an error at render that names it and the brands that ship; no other brand's mark is shown in its place.
With `tagline` and `wordmark`, the wordmark and the tagline stack in a `brand-lockup`; without `wordmark` the tagline is not shown.

aria: alt is the brand name, or empty when text names it.

theming.brandOverlay: This is the one component that varies by brand, and only in which mark it shows (the `brand` prop). Size and spacing are the same for every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The wordmark truncates; the mark never shrinks.
contract:
contract
  slot is "brand-mark"
  when lockup shows span "nyuchi"
end

checks.say: With the wordmark the images are decorative.
Mukoko shows the Mukoko pair, named.
Mukoko's light-surface image is the mukoko icon.
Mukoko's dark-surface image is the mukoko icon.
The Mukoko root names its brand.
The Mukoko wordmark is the brand name.
Kweli shows the Kweli pair, named.
Kweli's light-surface image is the kweli mark.
Kweli's dark-surface image is the kweli mark.
The Kweli lockup's wordmark is the brand name.
The Kweli lockup carries its tagline.
In the lockup the images are decorative.

gaps: Nyuchi, Mukoko and Kweli ship. Bundu, Mzizi and the other sub-brands need their mark pair added (scaled to 128px, never redrawn) before their dashboards can adopt the standard.
